transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I guess... mostly my appetite. For the last few weeks I just haven’t really wanted to eat. Even stuff I usually like after work, I kind of just stare at it and force down a few bites.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?

Yeah… most days, I guess. It’s not like I’m crying all the time or anything. It’s more like this heavy, flat feeling I carry around. Even at home with my family, or just sitting in the break room, I feel kind of… not really there.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Yeah… I think so. I used to look forward to running in the mornings, or messing around on guitar, cooking dinner sometimes. Lately I just… skip it. It all feels like another chore, I guess.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Yeah… I mean, I’m not planning to hurt myself or anything. But… sometimes I do think it wouldn’t be so bad if I just didn’t wake up and didn’t have to keep pushing through all this.
Did something stressful happen in your life shortly before all this started?
Yeah… it started maybe three weeks ago. Around when the casino reorganized security and moved my assignments around. I don’t know if that’s the whole reason, but… that’s when it seemed to start.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work or at home?

Yeah… mostly work. I’m still showing up, getting through the basics, but I’ve been making mistakes I don’t usually make. Documentation stuff, and I missed a surveillance cue. I got a formal warning, so… yeah, it’s starting to affect things.
Have these feelings been present nearly every day for at least two weeks?
Yeah… pretty much. It’s been about three weeks now, since they changed things around at the casino and moved my assignments.
Are you avoiding food because you’re worried about gaining weight?
No… it’s not about gaining weight. I just… I barely feel hungry lately. Even stuff I’d normally eat after a shift, I kind of just stare at it and force a few bites.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?
I mean… a little, maybe. I haven’t really been keeping track. Some nights I’m just not sleeping great, but… I don’t know.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy lately?
I don’t know… maybe a little. I haven’t really paid attention to it. Some days I feel kind of worn down, but it’s hard to say if it’s unusual.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

Yeah… some. At work, when I’m watching the CCTV screens or trying to write incident reports, my mind kind of drifts. I end up rereading the same thing a bunch of times, and I’ve made a few mistakes I normally wouldn’t.
Have you been feeling especially anxious or on edge lately?
Not really sure. I mean, I get tense sometimes, I guess, but I wouldn’t say I’ve noticed being especially on edge.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual lately?
Yeah… I guess so. At work, a couple people have mentioned I’m kind of slower in briefings. Takes me longer to answer sometimes, like I’m… a step behind. My body too, maybe.
When you’re away from anything related to the job change, do the low mood and loss of interest still feel just as strong?
Yeah… it’s still there. Even when I’m home, or just sitting around on break, it’s like this heavy, flat feeling. I’m there, but I don’t really feel… present, I guess.
Do these feelings seem stronger than you would expect just from the job change?
Yeah… I think so. It feels bigger than just the job stuff. Most days it’s like this heavy, flat feeling I’m carrying around, even at home or in the break room. Like I’m there, but not really there.
Before this job change happened, had you ever had another period like this in your life?
I don’t really know. I mean… not like this that I can remember. Maybe I’ve had rough stretches, but nothing I’d really call the same.
Lately, have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty?
I don’t know… not really worthless, I guess. Guilty? Maybe a little sometimes, but not like… I don’t think it’s excessive. Hard to say.
If the work reassignment were resolved tomorrow, do you think you would still feel this depressed?

I think… yeah, probably. Maybe it’d take some pressure off, but most days it still feels like I’m carrying this heavy, flat feeling around. Even at home with my family, I’m just kind of… not really there.
